ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast ratio characterized by dominant low-intensity pixel values (near-black); high-intensity pixels (white) are restricted to <3% of the total visible surface area, primarily at distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark-pixel distribution across >95% of the fluke surface. Contiguous high-intensity geometric clusters are mapped exclusively to the distal lobe tips. Sparse, stochastic white pixel-point clusters are scattered across the posterior zones of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 88 degrees; notch apex depth is roughly 12% of the fluke's total vertical pixel height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged boundary detected along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 4 and 12 pixels, with higher-amplitude deviations located near the distal ends.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature sweeping laterally and upwards from the median notch towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, irregular clusters of high-intensity pixels (calcified growths) detected at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes. Isolated circular white clusters (2-5 pixel diameter) are present in the medial region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization present as localized, high-contrast white clusters at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
